from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"test/fuzzing/chrono-duration.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":79,"var":"data[0]","code":"const auto representation = data[0];","note":"The first attacker byte selects the duration representation type used by the fuzz target."},
  {"step":2,"file":"test/fuzzing/chrono-duration.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":80,"var":"data[1]","code":"const auto period = data[1];","note":"The second attacker byte selects the chrono period specialization that will be instantiated."},
  {"step":3,"file":"test/fuzzing/chrono-duration.cc","function":"invoke_outer","line":29,"var":"rep","code":"const Rep rep = assign_from_buf<Rep>(data);","note":"The next fixed-size bytes are copied into the chosen duration representation, making the numeric value attacker-controlled."},
  {"step":4,"file":"test/fuzzing/chrono-duration.cc","function":"invoke_outer","line":35,"var":"format_str","code":"const auto format_str = fmt::string_view(as_chars(data), size);","note":"The remaining bytes become the format string that drives chrono formatting behavior."},
  {"step":5,"file":"test/fuzzing/chrono-duration.cc","function":"invoke_inner","line":12,"var":"value","code":"auto value = std::chrono::duration<Rep, Period>(rep);","note":"The attacker-controlled representation is wrapped into the selected std::chrono::duration type."},
  {"step":6,"file":"test/fuzzing/chrono-duration.cc","function":"invoke_inner","line":17,"var":"format_str,value","code":"fmt::format_to(std::back_inserter(buf), format_str, value);","note":"The fuzz target passes the attacker-controlled format string and duration into fmt's formatter, which will dispatch into chrono formatting code."},
  {"step":7,"file":"include/fmt/chrono.h","function":"chrono_formatter::on_second","line":1782,"var":"std::is_floating_point<rep>::value","code":"if (std::is_floating_point<rep>::value) {","note":"Floating-point duration reps take the branch that formats seconds into a temporary buffer and then writes directly to the output iterator."},
  {"step":8,"file":"include/fmt/chrono.h","function":"chrono_formatter::on_second","line":1791,"var":"out","code":"if (negative) *out++ = '-';","note":"The formatter performs a direct byte write to the destination before copying the buffered digits."},
  {"step":9,"file":"include/fmt/chrono.h","function":"chrono_formatter::on_second","line":1792,"var":"out","code":"if (buf.size() < 2 || buf[1] == '.') *out++ = '0';","note":"A second direct write can occur immediately after the sign write, so a too-small destination can be overrun by these sink writes."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
